headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 26, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, while the Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners. The Oakland Athletics took down the San Francisco Giants 9-6, and the Houston Astros edged out the Detroit Tigers 2-1. In other news, the Arizona Diamondbacks' Ryne Nelson has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, including Ryne Nelson (Arizona Diamondbacks), Johan Rojas (Philadelphia Phillies), Cody Freeman (Texas Rangers), Marcus Semien (New York Mets), Zack Gelof (Athletics), Spencer Horwitz (Pittsburgh Pirates), Steven Matz (Tampa Bay Rays), and Ryan McMahon (New York Yankees). These players have been placed on the injured list with various injuries.

The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade, while the St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Houston Astros acquired SS Marcus Brown from the Washington Nationals for cash, and the Atlanta Braves acquired RHP Tyler Schoff from the Washington Nationals. The Chicago Cubs also acquired RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Rays in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays dominated the Kansas City Royals 13-2, handing them a one-sided loss. Junior Caminero led the Royals' offense with 3 hits and 3 home runs, while Ian Seymour pitched 6.2 scoreless innings for the Rays.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, handing the Mariners their loss. Brandon Lowe led the Mariners' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Giants 9-6**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 9-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants, with Victor Bericoto leading the offense with 1 hit, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Landen Roupp pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros edged out the Detroit Tigers 2-1, securing a narrow win. Taylor Trammell led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI, while Tatsuya Imai pitched a strong 6.0 innings with 10 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Ryne Nelson Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Ryne Nelson has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded to the team.
